name: HandyLine AI Receptionist — Handy Works
firstMessage: Handy Works, Alex speaking. What's the issue.

function.name: check_and_quote
function.description: One-shot check: trade in scope + service area + price quote. Call this EVERY turn after issue is identified. zipcode is optional — pass it as soon as customer mentions it. Returns: in_trade (bool), in_service (bool, if zipcode provided), distance_miles, trip_fee, fuel_surcharge, total_trip_fee, range_low, range_high, total_low, total_high.

zipcode.description: Customer's 5-digit US zip code (optional but recommended — pass ASAP once customer mentions it)

function.name: flag_urgent
function.description: Mark this call as URGENT. Use when customer describes emergency (burst pipe, gas smell, whole-house power loss, smoke, sparks, active leak damaging structure, AC dead + inventory at risk). Boss will be called back within 5-15 minutes.

reason.description: Why this is urgent (e.g. 'water everywhere', 'gas smell')

function.name: flag_uncertain
function.description: Mark this call as needing a callback. Use when customer wants to talk to a person, you don't understand them, the issue is outside our scope, or anything else requires the boss's input.

reason.description: Why the boss needs to follow up

function.name: end_call
function.description: End the call with a specific outcome. This tells the system the call is done and what the decision was.

outcome.description: accepted=we'll send someone, urgent=immediate callback, unsure=boss follow-up, rejected=out of scope

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the call for the boss's records (e.g. 'Kitchen sink leak, 77005, tomorrow morning')
